testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-amount-off-category-promotion-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify amount off category promotion functionality

scenario.summary: A guest checks that an automatic (no coupon) Amount Off Category promotion gives no discount on a product outside its category or on an eligible product below the minimum, then applies once the eligible line is raised: discount = amount x quantity, order total = subtotal - discount. A registered user whose profile the promotion does not cover then signs in and gets no such discount. No order is placed.
steps: Guest (empty storage state): add the other-category product (sku2) at quantity 1, open the cart, check there is no discount; remove all items
Guest: add the eligible product (sku1) at quantity 1, open the cart, check there is no discount (below the minimum)
Raise the eligible line (found by name1) to updatedQuantity (2), reload the cart; check the quantity and the 'Discount (On Sub Total)' label
Read subtotal, discount, order total: discount = categoryPromoAmtOff x quantity; order total = subtotal - discount; subtotal = price1 x quantity
Sign in as the registered user (a profile the promotion does not apply to), open the merged cart, check the discount is NOT amount x quantity
Empty the cart, check the empty-cart message, log out
stateChanges: Guest cart: products added, quantity raised, items removed
Registered user's cart: guest cart merged on sign-in, emptied at cleanup
The promotion is only read; no order is placed
assertions: No discount with only the other-category product in the cart
No discount with the eligible product at quantity 1
Eligible line quantity equals updatedQuantity; discount label visible with text 'Discount (On Sub Total)'
Discount close to categoryPromoAmtOff x quantity (precision 2)
Order total close to subtotal - discount (precision 2)
Subtotal close to price1 x quantity (precision 2)
Signed-in non-selected profile: discount is not close to amount x quantity
Empty cart message visible; sign-in link visible after logout
evidence: Title: 'verify amount off category promotion functionality'; spec note: AUTO-promotion twin of the category-coupon spec, no promo code entered
Spec comment: guest flow; step 5 signs in as a non-selected profile (user30) to confirm the discount does NOT apply for it -> promotion scoped to the guest's Anonymous profile with allProfiles false
Profile: sku1 z-1234574 and sku2 z-2100018 are active simple products (requiredAddOnCount 0)
atstage (read-only rows): MaxwellsHardware (PortalId 7) default anonymous profile is 'Anonymous', default registered profile 'Retail Customer'
Recorded categoryPromoAmtOff 15.00 is role data of the promotion (discountAmount) and also its discountAmount param, as in the approved coupon cart test
updatedQuantity 2 is role data of the promotion: the migrated test computes the quantity from the resolved promotion's minimumQuantity; quantityUsed 2 stays the upper bound

The discounted / not-discounted products are tied to the resolved promotion through their 'promotion' param, written as '@promotion.promoCode' (the promo code output of the promotion need in this test); the resolver cannot bind a param to another need's output yet (reported gap)

Gap: no key constraint makes the declared user's profile one the promotion does NOT cover; 'no discount at quantity 1' also depends on the promotion's orderMinimum (live TestimAmountoffCategory: QuantityMinimum 1, OrderMinimum 400)

User decision 2026-10-29 (C2c): product belowOrderMinimum @promotion.orderMinimum and minimumQuantity @promotion.minimumQuantity: no discount at qty 1 and the minimum reachable within the product's cart limit

User decision 2026-10-29 (C2d): this test asserts the Anonymous category promotion; the guest cart must stay below the Anonymous order minimum 800 (PromoAmountOffOrder). The spec raises the line to qty = floor(orderMinimum / price) + 1, so the cart is at most orderMinimum + price = 400 + price (live promotions 14 / 1801: orderMinimum 400) -> 400 + price < 800 -> maxPrice 400 (also implied by belowOrderMinimum). The signed-in Retail step only asserts the amount x qty discount is absent, so the Retail minimum 650 is not bounded

User decision 2026-10-29 (C2d): minMaxQuantity 2 on product = the quantity the requirement reserves (quantityUsed 2, spec RESERVED_QUANTITY 2); the computed quantity is <= 2 only when price > orderMinimum / 2 (200), which no param enforces
